title: Motorradfahrer nach Verkehrsunfall in stationärer Behandlung

extraction.summaryEn: A 92-year-old driver and a 37-year-old motorcyclist collided at a crossing in Rummelsburg after the car allegedly failed to yield. The motorcyclist suffered bruises and abrasions and was taken to hospital; he lacked a valid licence and the motorcycle was wanted for embezzlement.
